gaps.sentence: The test measures your ___ (STRONG) in each skill.
gaps.explanation: 'Strength' is the noun; 'strengthen' is the verb 'to make stronger'.

gaps.sentence: She was ___ (ABLE) to attend because of illness.
gaps.explanation: 'Unable to attend' — negative of able is unable.

gaps.sentence: He is one of the most ___ (INFLUENCE) thinkers of the decade.
gaps.explanation: 'Influential' describes a person who influences others.
'Trustworthy' = deserving trust; 'trusted' also works but 'trustworthy' is the quality.
'A tendency to do something' — noun from tend.

gaps.sentence: Send your ___ (APPLY) to the address below.
gaps.explanation: 'Your application' — the document you send; an applicant is a person.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (SUSPECT) of fraud last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Was suspected of' — passive; 'suspicious' describes a person who suspects.
